test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below shows the sales of 7 different companies. The total sales of all these 7 companies are 2880. The sale of a particular company is shown in terms of degree with respect to the total sales of all these 7 companies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46f7d4fbb23e448ecb1191ea1f63b569ae0f8a4938aa8d65b8c824d6fa572903.png] 

 

The average sales of G and H is how much percent more than the average sales of D and I?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Average sales of G and H = (13° + 73°)/2

⇒ 86/2 = 43° 

Average sales of D and I = (17° + 53°)/2

⇒ 70/2 = 35° 

Average sales of G and H is more than the average sales of D and I = 43 - 35 = 8° 

Percentage = (8/35) × 100 = 22.86%

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
